reviewSamples.author: Photo of Brenda Ashley
reviewSamples.text: We have been taking our dogs here for years now.  We previously had to elderly dogs before these two.  They come home looking good and smelling good. I highly recommend Adorable Pets By Dena.

reviewSamples.text: I have been taking my Schnauzer,  Savannah there for 12 years and she loves to go! Well, now I have another dog Bailey, and he was not a good boy on his first trip but now all is good and he is doing much better.
